.darma-loader-tw-conic-spinner { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size, 56px); height: var(--loader-size, 56px); border-radius: 9999px; background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0deg, var(--loader-color, #3b82f6) 320deg, transparent 360deg); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 62%, #000 63%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 62%, #000 63%); animation: darma-loader-tw-conic-spinner-twSpin var(--loader-speed, 1s) linear infinite; }
@keyframes darma-loader-tw-conic-spinner-twSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
